title.narrative: Deutsche Beteiligung an der 10. Wiederauffüllung des Special Development Fund (SDF 10)
German Contribution to 10th Replenishment of the Special Development Fund (SDF 10)

description.narrative: A central component of SDF 10 is the reduction of the economic and social consequences of COVID-19 and strengthening social, economic and environmental resilience. Intended are in particular measures to strengthen the health and education system and to A basis of social security, to promote micro, small and medium-sized Company. Gender equality, good governance, digital transformation and regional cooperation and integration. 75 percent of Replenishment volumes should benefit the areas of environment and energy.

Zentraler Bestandteil des SDF 10 ist die Minderung der wirtschaftlichen und sozialen Folgen von COVID-19 sowie die Stärkung von sozialer, wirtschaftlicher und ökologischer Resilienz.
